speaker: alse_pinder
text: The loaf is out. It is the same loaf as yesterday, which is to say it does not reach the notch.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Threepence, and he knows it. Do not make a speech of a penny loaf, Alse. He has another old man to be at two.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Egeon again. I will eat what is here. The desk is as I left it. Leave it.
